reason: I lost a lead last month because nobody followed up, and I am answering emails at midnight. If an AI sales co-worker chases leads and handles the routine support mails, 99 euros a month is cheaper than one lost deal, so I would book the demo and take the monthly plan, not the yearly one yet.
objection: Where does my customer data actually go? 'GDPR-compliant' is one line on a website; I want to know where it is hosted, who can see it and whether I can get it all back out if I leave.
would_change_my_mind: If the demo cannot show me clearly where my data is stored in the EU and give me a data processing agreement, I walk away.
